title: Apple security updates
rawTitle: TTCSIRT-112.042518: TT-CSIRT Advisory – Apple Security Updates
leadParagraph: Apple has a released a security update stating that the following vulnerabilities have been discovered in the macOS 10.13.4:
contentHtml:
Apple has a released a security update stating that the following vulnerabilities have been discovered in the macOS 10.13.4:

a) A memory corruption issue was addressed with improved error handling which could lead to an application may be able to gain elevated privileges – CVE-2018-4206

b) A spoofing issue existed in the handling of URLs where processing a maliciously crafted text message may lead to UI spoofing – CVE-2018-4187

Further information on these vulnerabilities and how they can be mitigated can be found on the Apple Website at https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT208742
